column1: # selftest-inputs.tsv — the kit files each --kitselftest row of conformance/verify.sh reads (SWAS-1008).
# Kit-authored and shipped. Lines are `<row><TAB><path or glob>`; a glob's `*` is any run of characters, `/` included, and a path
# holds only letters, digits and `. _ / * + -`. Three more forms: `@all<TAB><path>` (an edit to that file runs every row);
# `<row><TAB>!<path>` (one exact path left out of that row's inputs, agent-autonomy's alone); a `#` line is a comment.
# The exporter writes conformance/kit-release.sha256 from these lines: the sha256 of every shipped file one of them matches.
# Nothing skips a row because of this file yet: that needs an `@hermetic` line, which a later PR adds per row after its plant cell.
# KEPT CURRENT by the census in `verify.sh --selftest`: every row here is a registry row; every --kitselftest row has lines or is on
# that census's ledger (with its reason); a row's own script is one of its inputs; every glob matches a file the default export ships;
# agent-autonomy's lines equal aa_input_list on the tracked files; no line reaches profiles/ (the manifest is profile-independent);
# scripts/ lines are exact paths (incept adds files there). It cannot see a row that starts reading a file listed nowhere (SWAS-1014).
# Edits to these files run every row, so a PR cannot drop a line here, or edit the files that decide the skip, unseen.
# agent-autonomy: exactly aa_input_list (conformance/agent-autonomy.sh): every file under .claude/, every .kit/*.conf but six that
# are export-ignored (incept stamps two of them, so they must not read as inputs), every adapters/*/adapter.json, and eight scripts.
# The rows whose selftest the inventory (docs/reviews/2026-11-23-selftest-hermetic-inventory-1008.md) read in full and found to read
# only these kit files and its own temp fixtures. Every shared library a row sources is an @all line above.
